questions.learningObjective: Interpret a confidence interval for a population mean

questions.stem: A memo reports p=0.001 with alpha 0.05 for a new park design. What is the decision?

options.text: Increase alpha to 0.10
Fail to reject; p is too small
Accept the null as true
options.misconception: confuses fail to reject with proof

options.text: Reject the null; strong evidence against it

questions.explanation: Since 0.001 is below 0.05, reject the null. Failing to reject or changing alpha is incorrect.

questions.learningObjective: Explain why a log transform helps skew
questions.stem: A planner log-transforms a right-skewed cost variable. Explain why this helps modeling.

answer.exemplar: A log transform compresses the right tail, reducing skew and stabilizing variance so a linear model fits the transformed values better.

questions.explanation: Logging pulls in the long right tail, reducing skew and variance heterogeneity. It does not remove outliers but lessens their influence.

questions.stem: An ANOVA has between-group df 3 and within-group df 16. How many groups are compared?

questions.topic: Slope of a line of best fit
questions.stem: Given covariance 12 and variance of x 4, compute the slope of the least-squares line.
questions.explanation: Slope equals covariance divided by variance of x, 12/4=3. Multiplying or inverting gives wrong values.
